title: FA Player Extensions Cross Mod Fixes
description: Adds tweaks to the FA Player Extensions that cleans up the game play while using other mods.
body:
# **--- NOT AN OFFICAL FA MOD ---**
# 

##Change Log

**V1 6-11-26
**
Allows you to play emotes from the Essential Mod even when Player Extension animations are active. It won't effect the animation of other players around you while you emote. (For Player Extension must have a ETF)
